A '''medical droid''' was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces at the [[Defiant Core]] base on [[Innton II]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the base was established, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was old.<ref name="Strongholds" />
